title: VRChat
provenance: Asked by Chestnutree04 (highball-db#156, 2026-09-20, M1 Pro, macOS 27.0, Highball 0.9.32): the game stops at 'Failed to load the anti-cheat module'. Are We Anti-Cheat Yet? (MIT): Easy Anti-Cheat, 'Supported' on Linux through the runtime EAC ships for Proton, which has no macOS counterpart.
notes: Anti-cheat: Easy Anti-Cheat. On Windows it loads a kernel driver, which Wine cannot run, and the Linux route (EAC's own Proton runtime) does not exist for macOS, so the launch stops at 'Failed to load the anti-cheat module' on every engine and graphics mode. Linux/Proton status 'Supported' does not apply to macOS.

anticheat.note: kernel anti-cheat; cannot work under Wine on macOS
